positions.commentary: The speaker has owned this stock for over 20 years and has not bought or sold it, noting it has compounded at a good rate.
The speaker suggests that if an investor finds a great business like Costco, they should hold onto it.
The speaker cites Shopify as a case study in the 2021 version of the book, comparing it to 2001 Amazon.com.
The speaker states that whether one loves or hates Tesla, there are many interesting aspects to it.

thesis: This episode argues that investors should focus on owning great businesses for the long term, citing examples like Costco and Berkshire Hathaway. It also highlights the importance of understanding real options and reflexivity in companies like Tesla, noting that stock prices can affect fundamentals.
